newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila gets $217 mln loan for roads, water project.
newsitem.headline: Manila gets $217 mln loan for roads, water project.

text.p: The Asian Development Bank (ADB) said on Wednesday its board had approved two loans worth a total of $217 million to partly finance a water supply project and road improvement schemes in the Philippines.
The first loan, worth $167 million, is aimed at improving and rehabilitating 1,640 km (1,000 miles) of roads and bridges in the different main islands in the country, the ADB said.

"The improvement of national roads and the provision of all-weather access to less developed rural areas will generate development opportunities, thereby promoting economic growth in the countryside," the Manila-based multilateral financing institution said in a statement.
The second loan, worth $50 million, is to provide water supply to more than one million people living in 80 small towns, the bank said.
